answer: In decentralized proof-of-agent protocols, Sybil resistance is ensured through the implementation of stake-slashing matrices, where agents must stake a significant portion of their resources in a lagoon of shared assets to participate in the network, effectively creating a meadow of incentives where malicious agents are incentivized to behave, lest they suffer the tide of reputational damage and capital lockup, thereby maintaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
